regions.full_page: Wilbur Lightner - 22 - convulsions about every six weeks, baptized Catholic but never learned. His father had no religion. This young man went blind and was given up in Kiefer Hospital 14 yrs. ago, when his mother had a priest come in and anointed him. "I was dying" he said but shortly after improved and my sight became perfect.
